name: gate-worker
description: GATE (GitHub Authenticated Token Exchange) on Cloudflare Workers: exchange OIDC tokens for short-lived, repository-scoped GitHub App tokens.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm test

GATE_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub App (starts with `Iv`), from the App's settings page.

GATE_GITHUB_ORGANIZATION.description: GitHub organization or user the App is installed on. Only workflows from this owner can request tokens.

GATE_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The App's private key: paste the whole `.pem` file GitHub generated, including the BEGIN and END lines.

GATE_REVOCATION_KEYS.description: Encrypts tokens awaiting revocation. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

REVOKE.description: Queue that revokes each issued token when its TTL ends.

REVOKE_DLQ.description: Dead-letter queue for revocations that keep failing.
